title: NCAA Football 2004
notes: The game opens with a Save Error screen: it cannot create its save file here, so settings and Season Mode progress are lost when you leave. Press 5 to continue.

On the play-call screen each of the three plays shown is picked with the key under it (1, 5 or 3); the direction pad pages through more plays. Your team's plays are the bottom row when you are the away team.
The right soft key pauses a game (Resume, Replay, Timeout, Settings, Quit).
Quick taps are sometimes missed by this game; hold a key a little longer if nothing happens.
Multiplayer needs Bluetooth and a second N-Gage and is not available in the browser.

controls.source: The game has no controls screen. Select (5) and Back (7) are from the labels at the bottom of its menus, and 1, 5 and 3 from the labels on the play-call screen; the soft keys, OK and the direction pad were observed in menus, play calling and the pause menu. The keys used during a down (snap, pass, tackle) could not be told apart by watching and are not listed; the pass-play diagrams label receivers 7, 4, 5 and 3.

actions.left: Change team (team selection); page through plays (play calling)
actions.right: Change team (team selection); page through plays (play calling)
actions.5: Select / continue (menus); pick the middle play
actions.7: Back (menus, where the screen shows it)

notes: The keyboard uses the standard layout: arrows, Enter, Q and W for the soft keys, and the digit row for 1, 3, 5 and 7.
On a gamepad X, A and B pick the left, middle and right play (keys 1, 5 and 3), A also selects in menus, Y is Back (7), and Start pauses.

statusNote: Legal and title screens, the main menu, team selection and the coin toss work, and a Play Now game (Air Force at Army) runs at full speed: kickoff, play calling and several downs were played, and the pause menu works. On every start the game reports "Save Error: unable to create save game space" (the console shows it cannot open C:/System/Apps/6RAZ/options.dat), so options and season progress are not kept.
